name: Stripenose the Tuxedo Cat
blurb: Stripenose, a black tuxedo shorthair with a thin white nose stripe, white bib and olive-green eyes, greets every neighbour at the garden gate.

name: Whiskerbib the Tuxedo Cat
blurb: Whiskerbib, a glossy black cat with a white chest bib, extra-long white whiskers and green-gold eyes, naps on the softest garden cushion.

name: Porchwave the Tuxedo Cat
blurb: Porchwave, a shy, cuddly black-and-white tuxedo cat with a white-striped nose, sits on the garden step to say hello to anyone close by.
